data.name: LakshmiMenon
data.gender_notes: LakshmiMenon is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lakshmi is the Hindu goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. Menon is a common surname in India, derived from the Malayalam word ‘man’ meaning man. Thus, LakshmiMenon is a name that signifies the divine blessings of wealth and prosperity, and is commonly found among Hindu families. The name LakshmiMenon carries the meaning “Fortune, Prosperity, Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose LakshmiMenon usually hope their child will grow to embody fortune, prosperity, wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Invocation of Goddess Lakshmi for material and spiritual abundance.
data.etymology: LakshmiMenon belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortune, Prosperity, Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of LakshmiMenon total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: LakshmiMenon is a name that represents the rich cultural heritage of India. Lakshmi is an auspicious name associated with blessings and is often invoked during Hindu rituals and ceremonies for the prosperity and wellbeing of family and community. Menon signifies a strong connection to the traditions and customs of Malayalam culture.
data.spiritual_significance: LakshmiMenon holds a deep spiritual significance for the Hindu believers. Lakshmi is considered the embodiment of material and spiritual wealth, and her blessings represent abundance, prosperity, and contentment. Menon signifies the man or individual who receives and embodies these blessings. Therefore, LakshmiMenon is a name that signifies both spiritual prosperity and earthly material blessings. It is a reminder that material wealth is a manifestation of the divine blessings and is a means to serve and sustain oneself and one's loved ones.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Lakshmi Menon: Goddess Lakshmi, the embodiment of wealth and prosperity, joined with the rational, intellectual pursuit of knowledge symbolized by "Menon" - a title denoting wisdom. Together, they represent the harmonious blend of material and spiritual wealth.

historical_references.reference:
Lakshmi was the goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity in Hindu mythology. She was often depicted sitting on a lotus flower and holding a lotus bud in her hand, symbolizing the abundance and creation of life.
Source: Encyclopædia Britannica.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient India (circa 4th century BCE - 13th century CE)

historical_references.reference:
Menon was a prominent Tamil poet, scholar, and philosopher in the 14th century CE during the Alvar period in Tamil Nadu. He was a devotee of Goddess Lakshmi and composed several works in Tamil extolling her virtues.
Source: South Asian History.
Note: This is a historical reference for the name Menon and not directly related to Lakshmi, but it adds context to the name as a whole.
